Use a complete http or https link and check that it has a server address.
The server responded, but rejected this request. Check the link and subscription access, or contact the subscription provider.
The subscription link was not found (HTTP %1$d)
The link may have expired or its address may be incomplete. Check it with the subscription provider.
The subscription server returned an error (HTTP %1$d)
The server is reporting a problem. It may be temporary; check the service status or try again later.
The subscription server returned this status. Check the link and subscription settings with the provider.
This can happen when the network is unstable or the server is slow or not responding. A timeout alone can’t tell whether the link is invalid. Check your connection and try again.
Could not reach the subscription server
The cause may be your network, DNS, the server address, or the server itself. This result alone can’t confirm that the link is invalid. Check the link and network, then retry.
The secure connection could not be established
Check the device date and time, network security software, and whether the subscription server’s certificate is valid.
The link redirected too many times
The subscription address may be redirecting in a loop or through too many pages. Ask the provider for a direct subscription link.
The profile is larger than the supported limit
Profiles must be 5 MB or smaller. Check that the link points to a single configuration file.
The server returned an empty file
There was no configuration content to import. Check that the subscription is active and the link is correct.
The server returned a web page, not a configuration
The link may open a sign-in, verification, or error page. Ask the provider for a direct subscription link.
The file downloaded, but its configuration could not be read
The content may be incomplete, malformed, or in an unsupported format. Check the source and try another configuration.
The selected file could not be opened
Choose the file again and make sure it is available to this app.
The profile could not be imported
The cause could not be identified clearly. Check the link or file and try again. If the problem continues, use the app’s diagnostics.
